purpose: Persist one explicit artist KEEP / REVERT / REVISE / INCONCLUSIVE judgment for the exact Reference and Current Song Versions shown in the existing A/B compare, without turning judgment into approval, execution, audio processing, or Learning promotion.

lineage.outcome: After hearing one exact local Version pair, the artist can explicitly record KEEP, REVERT, REVISE, or INCONCLUSIVE as durable judgment for that exact pair while current Version, approval, Learning, audio, provider, and DAW state remain unchanged.

why_now: The bounded pair-decision seam was selected after standards-based loudness evidence and Song credits/splits were integrated. Those adjacent systems remained separate from artistic decision authority.

implementation_contract.decision_truth: KEEP, REVERT, REVISE and INCONCLUSIVE are explicit artist judgments only. They do not imply approval, execution, preference promotion, causal Learning truth, or superiority.
implementation_contract.pair_binding: The decision action is bound to the exact active Song, Reference Version and Current Version prepared for the artist. The shell re-prepares and re-verifies the pair before accepting the write; stale or partially auditionable state fails closed.
implementation_contract.persistence: Decision history is append-only inside the canonical LineageStore database. GET inspection is read-only and does not create schema; the decision schema is initialized only behind an explicit authorized POST.
implementation_contract.authority: REVERT does not resume a Version, KEEP does not approve a Version, REVISE does not create a revision, and INCONCLUSIVE stays uncertain.
implementation_contract.memory_boundary: Recording this pair judgment creates no Learning episode or preference/taste promotion. Existing Learning remains the separate deliberate change -> observation -> decision memory.

completion_proof: existing /compare surface presents all four canonical artist judgment options only for a safely prepared two-sided exact pair
the action token carries no private Version IDs into rendered HTML and stale pair/current-Song state is rejected
recorded judgment survives restart and is queryable for the exact ordered Version pair
opening /compare without deciding creates no decision schema, decision row, Song/Version mutation, Learning write, or Activity event
REVERT records judgment without changing current Version or approved Version
replaying the same one-shot decision action is rejected
partial or integrity-blocked comparison offers no decision write
exact-head governance, full regression and staged consumer smoke passed on Linux, Windows and macOS

non_scope: audio gain, normalization or loudness processing
Learning episode creation, causal inference, preference promotion or Artist World doctrine update
